title: uks midcaps hit nearly one month low gilt yields surge 2026 09 02
text:
Sept 2 (Reuters) - London's ‌midcap stocks slipped to a nearly one-month low on Wednesday, extending losses as UK bond yields hit 19-year highs on renewed inflation fears after the U.S. and ​Iran exchanged fresh strikes in the Middle East.
The blue-chip FTSE 100 ​index (.FTSE)
, opens new tab
 fell 0.3% to 10,756.45 points, while the midcap FTSE ⁠250 index (.FTMC)
, opens new tab
 slipped 0.8% to its lowest since August 4.
